text:
Appendix 12: Return template for Oil Spill Response Organisations
Use this return template to submit annual or interim updates about your organisation's oil spill response capability, operational arrangements and any changes since your last submission.
The return should summarise any changes to your organisation, response capability and operational arrangements since your last submission. Supporting documents should be attached separately where required.
You should include details of:
- incidents responded to
- learning from incidents and exercises
- changes to administrative information
- changes to contractual agreements
- changes to operational information
- changes to your client base
- changes to equipment, stockpiles or premises
- changes to response personnel, training and responder competency
- any changes to your capability statement
- any other relevant information
The return must include the name of the Oil Spill Response Organisation (OSRO), indicate whether it is an annual or interim return, and be signed by an authorised representative.
